column1: # The notes application both programs implement, run in order against each:
#   start MAX_TEXT    (re)start the program on the same journal with that limit
#   break             the journal path becomes a directory: every write fails
#   restore           the journal is back where it was
#   log TEXT          what the program wrote since it started contains TEXT
#   field NAME VALUE  the previous answer carries the field NAME: VALUE
#   req METHOD TARGET AUTHORIZATION BODY STATUS RESPONSE_BODY
# AUTHORIZATION is the field's value (- for no field); BODY is sent with
# Content-Type: application/json (- for none). scripts/compare_notes.py fails
# if a program answers otherwise. The tokens are t-ada (user ada) and t-bo
# (bo); a note is visible to its owner only, and 404 to everyone else.
